facts.text: Herzing University Kenosha operates year-round with six start dates spread every two months and does not have campus dormitories.

sources.title: Kenosha Campus - Herzing University
sources.quote: We have 6 start dates spread across full year-round study, resulting in start dates about every two months.

sources.title: Kenosha Campus - Herzing University
sources.quote: Does Herzing University have dorms? No, we do not have dormitories.
